_note: Tagged narration for the one screen, one decision tutorial (the Wednesday 2026-09-30 reel), 15 second vertical cut, read on eleven_v3 by Sarah at the natural stability. The words are the ones in src/tutorial/onescreen/content.ts, which are the script in the day folder's brief.md as trimmed to fit 20 seconds and approved by Alex on 2026-09-24. Only the inline audio tags are added: src/tutorial/onescreen/scripts/voice.ts strips them and refuses to send anything whose stripped text is not exactly that narration. Direction: warm and confident throughout, a little playful on the hook only. No pause tags; the contrast read showed a pause tag renders as more than a second of dead air. Tags only ever go to the voice model: captions and the SRT read their own text from content.ts.
direction: Warm, confident, a little playful on the hook only.

beats.narration: [warm, a little playful] If a screen asks the learner to do two things, it does neither.
beats.why: The one playful line. A friend who has seen this screen a hundred times and finds it a little funny.

beats.narration: [confident] Read this, click that, answer this. Three screens pretending to be one.
beats.why: The list is the joke and needs no help. Said plainly and sure, so the verdict lands on its own.

beats.narration: [warm] We build one decision per screen. The learner acts, gets feedback, moves on.
beats.why: How we work, said the way you would explain it across a table.

beats.narration: [confident] Fewer clicks. More learning. That is the whole trick.
beats.why: Short sentences, no lift. The payoff is the plainness.

beats.narration: [warm] Free sample courses, link in the caption.
beats.why: An invitation, not an announcement. The url is on the end card, not in the voice.
